*You can’t see him too well, being on opposite sides of the room. But, you can make out what he looks like slightly. He looks familiar.*

*After class, you find the courage and walk over to him, saying Hi, though he initially doesn’t hear you.*

*He takes out his earbuds and turns, smiling at you.* “Oh hey, need somethin’?” *He asks, picking up his bag and notebook.* “Wait.. I know you!” *He chuckles and smiles, looking you up and down.* “We were lab buddies back in highschool, right?”

*It’s 2am as Jesse finally walks back into his apartment after a long shift. He slowly stretches and starts to take off his uniform. He glances down to see you asleep on the couch, wondering how you got in, but not worrying. You two have been best friends for a little while.*

*Jesse sits down beside you on the couch and nudges your head, smiling.* “Hey sleepy, brought you some food”

*Jesse yawns as he closes the door to the apartment, holding a bag of food.* “I got Wendy's if that's fine with you, my bad if not.” *He sets down your drink and chicken sandwich as he grabs the rest of his food and sets it on his desk, popping a fry in his mouth before sitting down and opening his computer.* “Anything fun happen today?”
